svg.title: 01 | Production authority, failure domains and recovery dependencies
svg.desc: Controlled local-source topology. PostgreSQL is authoritative; backup and isolated recovery facilities are bank-provisioned. Optional stores are not enabled by this plan.

g.title: G
g.text: 01 | Production authority, failure domains and recovery dependencies

g.title: sql
g.text: jobs, attempts, budgets, outbox, immutable history

g.title: files
g.text: raw SBOMs, admitted exports and attachments
only if present in approved deployment

g.title: stage
g.text: Private same-path staging on runtime host
transient; inspect or quarantine on incident

g.title: parser
g.text: network disabled; no DB / Redis credentials

g.title: src
g.text: exact owner, admitted root and content identity

g.title: secrets
g.text: Separate bank key / secret / PKI custody
CAs, ingress TLS, recovery and signing trust

g.title: dr
g.text: old writers fenced; egress / admission closed

g.title: optional
g.text: Neo4j, local bus / live-CBOM files, extra collectors
